profile.headline: Software Engineer at Avalara
profile.summary: As a skilled web developer, I specialize in PHP & MySQL development, VueJS support, and client collaboration, with a strong focus on optimizing performance, enhancing functionality, and ensuring seamless user experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
PHP & MySQL Development: Work extensively with PHP and MySQL to ensure the stability, optimization, and performance of the research website. I develop and maintain backend systems, perform troubleshooting, and ensure seamless user experience.

VueJS Support: Utilize VueJS to enhance and maintain features for state-specific Department of Revenue (DOR) workflows. This involves front-end development and collaborating with teams to implement new features and updates efficiently.

Client Collaboration: Work closely with a Fortune 500 company to ensure accurate handling of their exemptions, collaborating with multiple departments to deliver tailored solutions. My role involves troubleshooting, customizing functionalities, and ensuring that the system runs smoothly to meet the client’s needs.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Supported major client integrations for the Exemption Certificate system, working closely with key stakeholders to ensure accurate and efficient handling of exemption processes. My role involved collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate custom solutions, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring that client-specific needs were met, all while maintaining system integrity and optimizing user experience.
